doc.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999

title: Her son Charles with Chuck Mangione
summary: Her son Charles plays bass and sings with Chuck Mangione.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: All right. I understand Charles, your son is playing professionally with Chuck Mangione?
Oh yeah. He’s back with Chuck Mangione now.
He’s a bass player, isn’t he?

Yes, he’s a bass player and sings also. And I’m proud of his contributions. He’s quite a talented person. Quite a talented person. He was teaching school for a while but I think he kind of got — he wanted to perform some more years.
Well, it’s in his genes, right?
Yes, I think so. On both sides. His mother and father, so I guess he just wanted to do his thing. And I think he’s doing his thing now.
